# Custom partition table — ESP32-S3FN8 (: # We don't implement OTA updates in this firmware (reflashing over USB-C
# is the expected workflow for a pentesting tool you keep on a bench)
# the space that a dual-OTA scheme would reserve for a second app slot is
# given to LittleFS instead. That's what stores the OUI vendor database
# the default-credentials dictionary and exported scan results (JSON/CSV)
# all of which benefit far more from 3.9 MB of room than a second 4 MB app
# slot nobody writes to would.
# SubType "spiffs" below
# (gen_esp32part.py) validates SubType against a fixed keyword list
# that predates LittleFS support and has no "littlefs" entry — using it
# fails the build ("Value 'littlefs' is not valid"). This is cosmetic
# not functional: the SubType/Name fields are just labels for the
# partition table itself
no PSRAM): not a promise about which filesystem format
